text: Although the business judgment rule is articulated differently in the two countries and German law leaves somewhat more room to challenge risky decisions, in both the United States and Germany the rule is highly protective of corporate managers.
citation: Painter and Kaal, Initial Reflections on an Evolving Standard Constraints on Risk Taking by Directors and Officers in (2010). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1558614
